company_info.company_description: "Solenergy is a leading solar retailer offering a simple turnkey approach to installing solar to your home or business.Solenergy is a trusted, family owned and operated Aussie business. We pride ourselves on excellent customer service, trusted global brands and quality installations with industry leading workmanship warranties."

reviews.review_description: After requesting quotes from three different companies Solenergy was the only one to get back to me with a quote. The process was easy and the team who installed the system were punctual and completed the work quickly. I was connected to the grid and shown how to use the app on my phone to access information from the inverter.

Solenergy have been incredibly responsive to any questions I have had both before and after the installation.  Adam, the salesperson has been involved throughout the process and is still happy to answer any questions post installation.  Similary, Lisa from the customer service team has been very supportive.  The installation went without a hitch and the workers cleaned up everything before they left.  It was like they had never been.  I highly recommend Solenergy for a quality end to end experience.

Quoting process is easy to understand. Sale person is friendly and knowledgeable which made my choice easier.For the installation the staff is not friendly, not keeping me informed of what is happening. Left the job site without updating me or confirm with me that everything is done.The quality of the system is unknown at this stage. I only have it installed this morning.Customer service is good at first during the quoting and installation. Not sure about the service later on or maintenance or warranty yet!

There's nothing particularly unique about the process - it was good. There were no problems. I ended up picking Solenergy amongst the competition because the sales person stood apart from the other quotes I'd gotten.They guided me through how to read my meter and energy usage (because I'd just moved in I didn't have an energy bill yet).It wasn't the cheapest quote but I figured if they have the time to guide me through figuring out what kind of system is right for me, then I'm willing to give them my money.

The quote was detailed and well explained. My questions were answered, and I was left details to go over before making my decision. I was followed up a week later as planned and had my final questions answered. The installation was well organised and on time. The installer explained what was to be done then provided me with photos of the finished product and explained the system and how it worked. I was followed up by the team the next day with how the connection would take place. Everything was done for me.

Solenergy were fantastic to work with from beginning to end. I had a couple of challenges on my side getting ready and Lisa was very understanding and helpful. The overall setup was designed well with great communication, and installation went without a hitch. After I found a leak near one of the panels during heavy rain, Nick and the crew even came back to check it out and determined it probably wasn't related to their install, but siliconed it up and didn't charge me regardless.Great company who care about doing the right thing by their customers. Would definitely recommend.
Thank you to Adam and the team for an excellent experience from the first call to the final installation and commissioning. Can’t fault this company.

I've had an overall fantastic experience with Solenergy. Mark was very approachable and accommodating, happy to adjust our system/quote to ensure we chose the right system for us. He was flexible on brands/models but provided guidance on who he recommends. Their price was competitive with other quotes requested. Steven and his team installed the system efficiently but to a good quality, and were happy to explain everything as they were going. We have just had a government inspection of the setup (battery, panels, inverter) and they noted that it's one of the best installation they've assessed and given it as high score as they could. Overall 5/5 and would happily recommend Mark and Steven for anyone looking to install a solar setup.

Local business. The company's owner invested in our installation to be correct for our needs.He had great knowledge of the products he was recommending and the industry at large.The installation was prompt and went off without a problem.

Very good!Kept in contactThe install went in when they said it wouldOnly a little bit of mess to clean up but overall very happyThe guys were very friendly and very patient showing me how to download the app and hie it worked.It seems to be working a treat. Looking forward to seeing the results on out power bill
Great business to deal with from start to finish. Excellent customer service, very responsive and helpful and fast installation.
Friendly sales and superb service from the back office staff. Installers were super friendly and professional. Very happy

Their salesperson, Mark, knew his product well.  As I'm from the electricity sector, I probably had some more curly questions than usual.  Some other suppliers didn't have the same level of knowledge.    Mark was patient while I tossed options e.g. AC and DC systems back and forth, eventually settling on a 10KW DC Sungrow system with Hyundai panels.  The installation was arranged quickly and the quality of the workmanship was excellent.  I'm pleasantly surprised by the generation achieved on overcast days - eager to see how it performs in summer.
It was a pleasure dealing with them, very polite and professional.
Sales device was knowledgeable and helpful in explaining system instal and location etc.Installers were low fuss, friendly and do a neat and tidy job

Sales was fast and efficient, installation was seamless, polite, tidy and punctual. Customer service was on point and answered promptly when a callback was requested for an issue unrelated to install.

Reliable and helpful company. Extremely happy with the whole team.From Adam to Fourie and the rest of the installation team as well as Lisa who was always happy to answer any of our questions. A huge thank you to you all for your excellent work.
Fast, helpful and trustworthy.They had one of the best price offers and completed a very professional installation

Solenergy was fantastic at listening to our requirements and providing tailored quotes and different options to help us make the right choice for us.The installation went well and the quality of the installation was excellent.Still waiting for the final part to connect to the grid so we are excited to see how the new system makes  difference to out power usage.

Adam did amazing job during the quoting process, providing comprehensive details about the products offered and the process/steps involved. Price was reasonable and products were top notch. The installation was completed fast and the boys were friendly and completed the job done efficiently. Definitely recommend!
Solenergy have been great to work with right from the start. The sales rep was great, the installation team were prompt, finished before schedule and were clean and tidy.Highly recommended.

Despite meeting some awkward and unpredictable install issues the solar was completed in 1 day.Everyone was very friendly and professional. Everyone arrived on time. Installed within 2 weeks of quote. Some others were talking monthsThey also came out to troubleshoot the wifi issues, which didn't impact on the functionality of the system but were tricky for me as a little technology shy to rectify

Everything was fantastic, this company is a local family owned and Operated  business, and the service is above expectations.     Communication was fantastic, the helpfulness was unbelievable, always quick to get back to me, Lisa just bent over backwards

Sales/Quoting Process : Clear answers were given to all questions and at no time did I feel "pressured" to buyInstallation was prompt and seemed to me to show great attention to detail.Adam Ric and Ty made a great team and left me with the feeling that the choice of Solenergy was a good one.I would have no hesitation in recommending them to potential buyers of a solar system.Fred Taylor

Very professional from getting the quote from Adam Christie , to having it all installed and having everything explained , monitoring it on line in simple language for an old guy. The follow up service has been very good and will not hesitate to recommend Solenergy to any of my family and friends, Doug Young
Great customer service. Very transparent. Very punctual and customer service was awesome!

The quoting process was very well done and easy to understand.Issue 1: Work carried out was not as discussed with the inverter being installed not in the position discussed at time of quoting. The technician completing the install did not call to ask where he should place it.Issue 2: Sadly work quoted was not completed as per quote. With the power box upgrade not being done as quoted. (they asked for payment the day before)Issue 3: Install included conduit being run right down the bottom of the wall where it becomes a hazard as it is touching the grass, flexible conduit not pushed into hard conduit with wires being exposed.When I called to discuss these issues with the owner. He was quite rude, called me a liar when I said the installer never called. Was sarcastic when I asked why the power box wasn't installed as per quote. Said he would fix these issues if I paid more. Went on to say it was my fault for not being home on the day of install (I guess the installers need someone to keep an eye on them)I had originally organized to retain one of the  solar panels from the old install, the owner explained they couldn't let me keep one which I respect. He then said to make up for all the errors he would drop a second hand one they had tested off to my house. He didn't do that.The install works, I haven't been on the roof to check the panel install, looks good from the ground. I wouldn't use them again.

Quote was more detailed than the others, the salesman actually looked at my old system where the others didn’t.Lisa in the office was awesome, extremely helpful throughout the whole process and answered all my questions. Installation took a bit longer than expected apparently but by the time I got home from work it was all connected and up and running.
The work was completed as contracted very promptly and efficiently by a very hard working, polite install crew.

From then moment Adam came to quote us till we received all the warranties and sign off the communication has been excellent. Price was far less than we were expecting significantly cheaper than another quote with comparable products.We had a stack of questions which were answered thoroughly. install happened quickly and professionally. We are very happy we finally took the plunge. Adam and Lisa who we dealt with were very helpful and attentive.
Really helpful sales team and good onsite inspection. Was happy with the system price
Excellent customer service from everyone we dealt with throughout the process, it was all made so easy. Thank you!

They made the effort to understand our requirements and design a system that fitted with the roof designs and orientation.While it took a bit longer to install due to the difficulty of running wires with our house shape, there was no issue that they would do the job within the quoted price and without compromising the quality of the workThey always answered my dumb questions patiently and clearly.
Solenergy was first to come to us with a price. The others dragged their feet.

How was the sales/quoting process? Easy and straightfowrardHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? Yes to all.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install? Yes they did everything . It was excellent service

From the initial meeting through to implementation the team at Solenergy were quick and professional.Special thanks to Lisa for her patience in helping me get the app running.Fantastic end to end service I highly recommend Solenergy.

Mark was very friendly and easy to work with. He talked us through all our options and gave recommendations based on our home, our power usage and current solar equipment in the market.We had to rethink our inverter location on the morning of install due to some ventilation issues, but they worked with us to quickly adjust the plan and I actually think we ended up with a better solution in the end.

The quote process was very quick and Adam was super helpful with any questions I had. They installed it 5 days later which was a very impressive turn around. They had the most competitive price out of all the trusted installers. Highest of recommendations for Solenergy. Great experience.

Adam was fantastic from start to finish, we had quotes for multiple system sizes and brands we felt well informed and are really happy with the system we chose. The installation was able to take place 2 days after paying the deposit. I have already recommended Solarenergy group to neighbours who have noticed the new panels.

Experienced sales person, discussed best place to put panels on roof, and best place to put inverterInstallation team were contractors but did a good job and cleaned up everything ,and took away old system.Set up monitoring and showed how to monitor using my Android device.Customer service seemed a bit lax, failed to send final invoice when I  paid after install.( sent a invoice when deposit was paid , then a invoice with $0  to be paid before instal.?)No one has contacted me to ask if system is working OK and was I satisfied etc.Grid connection was already in place from old systemI arranged a new plan with Origin to suit the new solar system
Solenergy were great to communicate with. Excellent customer experience, and nothing was a problem…, thanx Lisa!!!
Easy as to arrange quotes. Installation was painless. Great Job.

Very happy with our installation. Got a 10KW system and no problems at all.The quoting process was very easy to following and answered any questions I had very quickly. Installation process was not a problem. The guys installing were polite and friendly and they arrived on time.All additional processes were undertaken by the installers. I had nothing to do.

The process of obtaining a quote, further explanation and installation went smoothly and very promptly. The work and cleanup was very tidy and grid connection was provided.Would recommend Solenergy as a reliable and informative installer.

From the first initial contact with Lisa, the consultation with Adam C and the installation with Adam L and his team, everything went smoothly and am very happy I chose Solenergy.Thank you Solarquotes  for having this information available to me, to make choices for future savings of both the environment and my pocket.
Incredible quick install from the install team and Mark and Lisa made setting it up and communication easy
From the sales team, to the installation team, the entire process was seamless and professionally installed

The entire process was seamless, from the first phone call to booking of on-site meeting, the installation and organising of grid connection. The Solenergy Group were very punctual and professional in all contact with me.

An experienced, knowledgable and professional solar company principal who delivered everything promised from quote to signing off. The performance and attitude of all in his team, both in the office and on site was exemplary.Solenergy honoured the quoted price despite extensive difficulty in gaining access to our convoluted roof and 27 degree pitch, took extreme care to look after our pristine property and were a pleasure to deal with at every level.I recommend the Solenergy team highly and would definitely use them again for another property

From quotation to installation Solenergy were a pleasure to deal with. The installation went without a hitch (polite, punctual and tidy tradies) and handover was managed professionally. Office staff were also pleasant and efficient and Dan was a real pleasure to deal with.

Everything from first contact from booking of on-site quotation to the installation of system and organising of grid connection Solenergy Group were very punctual and professional in all contact to us.

The sales/quoting process was explained down to a T and emailed in an easy to understand concept.The installation was seamless and quick. The team were polite and on time.Customer service was wonderful always kept in touch at every step.

The whole process was  so quick and smooth. They came out that day to perform the quote, talked me through everything and didn't pressure me to make any decisions.The install was quick and went exactly as planned.
All aspects went well from sales to installation and customer service. Early days but very happy so far.
Sales person was very helpful throughout the process and gave me loads of valuable information. It was very useful for me as a new comer to solar.
The whole process from sales quoting to finished install was on time and just as promised.
Highly recommend the solar quotes website and the company’s they deal with

I found Solenergy through the Solar Quotes website and quoting system.  I ended up getting 6 quotes from different suppliers.I chose Solenergy as Mark was very open and sincere and honest in his presentation and quoting, happy to answer in detail any questions I had, especially technical ones.  I was most satisfied that the products and design he suggested would work well for me.During all my interactions with Mark and his team, I found them to be on time, reliable, professional and courteous from the initial enquiry through to the final installation and grid connection, and receipt of completion documentation.The experience was so good, I told my brother about Solenergy. He is now getting them to install his solar system.I strongly recommend Mark and Solenergy to anyone considering installing solar.

Adam attended in person and sat down with me to explain everything in detail. His quote was the cheapest of 5 that I received, for the same equipment. Installers were a 3rd party, but highly capable and friendly, and did a great job (installing the whole 11kw system in less than a day). Highly recommended.

Supplier provided a competitively priced quote using well reviewed products (not the highest ranking products)Was the only supplier to send someone to site. Installation was OK, took a day longer than expected and some of the trades need a reminder of language while they're on site. My kids don't need lessons on swearing.after sales services has been excellent, they sent the sparky out to check something for me. would recommend.
This company is very good, I would recommend them to anyone.
Engagement process was informative and patient.  The process appeared to be well managed, things happened when they were planned to happen - no nasty surprises.

The service was amazing from the very start to end. They did spend the time to explain and find the best system to suit my need.The service was eficcient, clean and they spend the time to explain with further doubts I had after installation.I highly recommend their service and in the future if I move and need another system I will sure use them again

The business owner Mark came out and went through all options and explained everything in detail.The installation went well - They arrived on time, tidied up after them selves and were very polite. Due to weather they could not finish the instal on the day and came back the following week to complete.Overall I am very pleased with the system price & quality and so far the output has been as expected.

Quote was clear and competitive.Nice local company.All installed within 2 weeks.Solar up and running within 3 weeks from installation.Very happy with the panels, the invertor, the app and the free sunshine energy!Not so happy with the pigeons who immediately moved in, but found a company who could sort that out.
On site inspection by Mark Ridgley and design adjustments by Principal and-site visits during install very worthwhile.

The Solenergy guys were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Adam visited the site to design the installation - panel placement and inverter position. He arrived on time, was very knowledgeable and friendly. He responded very promptly to some questions that came to mind after his visit. The written quote he prepared was very detailed and competitively priced (almost identical in every respect with a quote provided by Sure Solar - I guess they use the same software package to generate their quotes).I know this is a review of my experience with Solenergy but I'd like to point out the Sure Solar guys were similarly great to deal with in the quotation process - it was pretty much a toss of a coin as to which one to choose. I think I would have been happy with either.The Solenergy installation was trouble free from my perspective, although I think there were issues with running cables from the inverter to the meter box due to limited roof space, but the electrician was able to overcome that and still have all the cables concealed. Job looks great - couldn't be happier with the outcome.The system appears to be operating as designed although it's only been a month.
Wasy process, competitive quote, punctual, friendly and responsive . Couldn't be happier

The company rang me and felt, they weren't happy with my review.There was a bit sarcasm in it and they didn't appreciate it.Even though, my statements are factual.It took 3 attempts to book me in. All the Wiring is surface ran, looks terrible to me and the tools/screws were found around the place.

Quote process went well and I told them they could put some panels on the north west street side of house so they accommodated.Some small problem with supplies at their end but that only delayed installation by one day.All good.
Solar system as promised, excellent communication, timely installation by efficient experienced electrician with two assistant technicians.

These guys were wonderful, start to end. The lovely lady that booked us in was professional and very accommodating. The gentleman that did our inspection and quote was very professional and provided multiple quotes on our request. He was very honest and knowledgeable about the products and the installation process. The installers arrived on time and were professional and courteous. The were very efficient and made sure that we were fully aware of all parts of the process. Our paperwork was submitted promptly and our energy provider confirmed that they had completed everything required to get our solar up and running. I cannot recommend Solenergy enough and would give them 10 stars if I could!

I had interviewed five companies before meeting with SOLENERGY. They were by far the best.Dan from Solenergy was professional, efficient and friendly and prices were fair. He went over and above to help me manage the booking around my personal situation.Communication was excellent.The Installation was smooth. They were on time and tidy.Dan followed up.I highly recommend SOLENERGY

They were very helpful and informative in the sales process. Installation was done promptly. They arranged the grid connection. I am waiting for them to get the monitoring app to work on the inverter.

From the initial quotation process, through to the instillation, nothing but professional.The installers turned up on time, were friendly, knowledgeable & help full.I had a couple of questions after the install and rang there customer service team, once again, they professional, super friendly and assisted me straight away with my questions.- excellent service and a pleasure to do business with this company, HIGHLY RECOMMEND the team at Solenergy if you want a quality the process to be hassle free

Both DE Energy and Solenergy provided great customer service and support. Their salespeople were both informed and reliable and are both reputable organisations. I would have no hesitation in recommending either business. I chose Solenergy purely on final pricing, although both were very similar.

We used an online site to provide 3 solar energy providers. A senior representative from Solenergy Group came to our home, explained the process and provided a quote....there was no hard sell, but he provided very useful information on solar production etc. On checking, all the information stacked up. that is very positive.We accepted the quote and paid a deposit. We continued to receive emails with useful information so we gained confidence that our deposit was secure. (Unfortunately with other companies we have dealt with, this confidence can be questioned.)The installers arrived on time and were helpful and courteous. They caused minimum disruption to our power supply and worked quickly and efficiently. The data  provided via the inverter was explained clearly to us as was the need for our energy provider to adjust our account. Just over a week later the solar power is up and working.The entire process has been efficient and very simple for us.
A no hassle, easy process with the company, from setting an appointment and having options explained to getting the system installed by a professional team - highly recommended.

The team was excellent all the way from the initial phone call to the ending installation. I rang them to discuss options and they took the time to explain as much as possible. No hard sell or 'we have a deal for you that runs out the end of the week, so sign up now'. Quote and design was done very quickly and only a few weeks later, the installation began.Installation team were professional, showed up on time and completed the job quickly and no disruption to us. Very courteous.Highly recommend
Really genuine sales person, not at all pushy, informative. Organised everything and offered good advice. Highly recommended.
Solenergy were very professional and installers were prompt and polite. Every thing went very smooth.

Really friendly, honest and straight forward sales process, combined with an ability to install the system quickly made for a stress free and straightforward process.Installation was on time, tidy and handled with care.
All round great quality, price and service. We couldn't be happier.

I found the sales and quoting process easy to understand and the changes I requested to my first quote were dealt with promptly and accurately.As soon as I accepted the quote the timeline information and contact I received was sent to me and I never felt like I had to chase down any information.Installation day was done without any issues and the installers were the most polite and friendly guys that I have had the pleasure to deal with.Follow up phone call was received and all the grid connections were done within 10 days.Great company to deal with!

Sales team are very helpful in identifying exactly what you need. Installation was quick and the team were tidy and walked me through how to operate the solar system. Follow-up service assisted in connecting the system to the grid, overall a great experience.

Quoting process was easy and they were happy to go over it in detail with me so it made sense.Installation was a simple process -they turned up when they said they would and everything was done in a very friendly but professional manner.They helped with the grid connection and made sure I understood what the process was and when things should be happening.

Solenergy came out to the house and sat with me for almost an hour discussing options and going through the process.  Was very informative.The installation was faultless, the guys took care and explained everything they were doing.   Very happy with the installation.

Solenergy were unreal, from the start to the end!!! Once I decided to go ahead, the panels were installed a  week later.. No fuss and amazing service. Thanks to Adam and Dan for their assistance, I highly recommend Solenergy.
Easy, informative process from start to finish. Weather conditions were not ideal and the initial crew soldiered on. Good follow up by solar retailer.

Salesperson was very informed and helpful. Bit early to assess quality of system and value for money but think we have a good quality system that is value for money. Time will tell. Installers were great. On time, very friendly, very professional, safe workers and good work ethic. Waited some time for Origin to connect the meter. Waiting for the Huawei inverter app to work to see how we are faring.

the sales and quoting system worked very smoothly and was easy to get the questions i had answeredVery happy with the installation they were on time polite and cleaned up everything before leaving siteThey sent through all the required requests to have the system completed with my electricity provider and after a few phone calls the provider done their part.i did have an issue with the factory settings on the inverter not being correct however this was addressed by the installer and all is working fine now.a lot of the work had to be done over the Christmas period which made things drag out but i am totally satisfied with the system i now have and the way it operates
From start to finish great support from the team.The install guys explained everything from start to finish

We’ve had our system just a little over a year now and am absolutely over the moon with the money we’re saving the solar products we ended up choosing and the service Solenergy provided. Adam guided us and gave us awesome advice of which would suit our family best! Solenergy were fantastic from start to finish and we couldn’t be happier with the products and services they have provided!!
Overall and good experience. Installation was on time and installers were polite and helpful. They stayed and explained the system to me and the post installation service has been good too.
It was all very easy and seamless.Grid connection was done for me as was the app for the system.
Settled for a 9.7kw system, at very good comparison price. The system was installed within 2 weeks by very competent tradies. Can recommend solenergy, for hassle free company

Awesome Team!!!! Very reliable and helpful. Prompt and polite. Totally recommend. Effortless and easy to deal with. I went through A LOT of companies before I felt comfortable enough to deal with Solenergy! And they sure didn't disappoint me. Job well done guys and girls!!

Hi Finn, all good, we had the installation done early July, up to now l can't think of a reason why we wouldn't give a 10/10. l went to work , came home... all done, l went through your check list, ie.. cover over isolater on roof etc... Adam was the sales guy and a very pleasant experience it was too. Our's was not an easy roof to deal with either, multiple sections, a few trees, however here we are in the middle of winter and we are pushing 5kW. So we're holding off with the pruning.... (we're from Yorkshire..). Solenergy organised grid connection and dust-box upgrade, Anyhow Finn, thanks again to you and the gang at Solar Quotes and Solenergy. Our best regards Paul and Jenny.

The service from the whole team was top notch, from Adam in sales through to the installation team who were flexible and worked around my Body Corporate. The installation and finance application process were both totally painless and the system was up and running in no time. A highly professional outfit. Would definitely recommend.

The whole process was made easy by the team at Solenergy. They communicated well throughout the process and let me know what would happen next. They did a very professional and tidy job installing the system and connecting to the grid on the day we had scheduled. Very happy!

Solenergy spent a lot of time talking with me and answering all the questions I had prior to issuing the quote. The price was the best and they were using products I trusted (from the SolarQuotes recommendations).We stumbled a bit on the installation, as the system had to be redesigned once they were on site and saw the roof pitch. That required a change to the inverter, but Solenergy stuck by their original quote. I think that shows trustworthiness!Solenergy arranged the other services – Energex and Red Energy - and kept us updated whole way.Peter and Mark were very professional and very easy to talk with.

Impressed with the technical expertise and thoroughness of the staff. Not the cheapest quote but a reasonable price for a quality system. Installation was on time, very professional, looks great and now working exactly as expected. Solenergy group organised everything including grid connection with minimal effort from me.
Good communication throughout process.Able to give me the system I wanted, choice of panels and inverter for a very competitive price
Very good all-round Would recommend to anyone looking to install a 6.6kw system

From the first call, it felt like a friend was calling to help a mate out. Next was the meeting in person which was very honest, direct and answered any and all questions i had about solar - very knowledgeable. No pressure to make a purchase at all then came the installation team who were more than happy to explain things and help. Even after sales service has been great. System runs smoothly exactly how it should. Cant fault in any way.
Pat was great to work with in figuring out the best system, and he organised to get it all installed very quickly.

The team at Solenergy were excellent. The salesman was upfront with all the information and knowledgeably about exactly what system we needed and would fit our purpose. This actually separated them from the other companies we got quotes from. Then the guys installing our system were clean and tidy, polite and professional. We feel that we got a good deal and a quality product. We would recommend Solenergy.

From the start Adam was great and answered all of my questions. He came out and inspected my roof as it was an odd shape. We sat down and worked out the layout of the panels.Installation was also top notch. The guys doing the install knew their stuff and were very accommodating as I had to have some roof tiles replaced due to hail. Installation was clean and looks great. Everything was tidied up and they arrived exactly when I was told they would.Dan and Mark have been great to deal with and answered my questions after the installation was complete. Very happy with the install and Solenergy

Out of the three solar companies to give me a quote, Solenergy was the only company to visit my house for a survey. The survey picked up on a couple of issues which would have caused issues and delay if not discovered until the day of installation.I was also able to discuss technical aspects such as cable layout, inverter type, with Adam.The cost and equipment was comparable with other quotes but because Solenergy had surveyed my house, this gave me a high degree of confidence that I wouldn't get any surprises down the track.The install was done on the appointed day with no issues. Installation was neat and professional.I'm waiting now on Energex to change my meters so can't comment on the system performance yet.
To invest alot, the returns should be equal or greater!We are super happy with the choice I made this time round...Thankyou

Adam was amazing. He was the first of 7 solar quotes we got and we both went back to him immediately. His attention to detail, prompt response time and willingness to work with what we wanted to achieve was a great first impression. When he came out his presentation was by far the most forthright and informative, he gave us and best options on size, panel placement and value for money and after he left we found it so much easier to ask other installers questions on our particular install type to ascertain the best value which ended up being with SolEnergy. Adam provided us with the best monetary value all round, choice of quality panels and inverters to suit our needs, flexibility in panel array and immediate install date that some others could not. An absolute asset to SolEnergy. The installers were lovely, hard working and flexible. They showed me everything I needed to get set-up and worked very hard in the hottest day of our heat wave! Good work boys!

Solenergy was the only company of the four we contacted, to send a rep out to talk to us.  Adam was very helpful with information and receptive to our thoughts and questions.  The quote was inclusive with a definite price for the alterations to the meter box, which wasn't the case with the other company we were looking at.  They were happy to adjust the quote for work we were able to arrange ourselves.The installation team arrived on schedule, were very pleasant, advised us each time they had to turn off the power and took away any debris they were left with.Customer service has been excellent, with phone calls and emails keeping us informed and answering any questions we had.  They contacted Energex and our supplier to arrange the grid connection, which went completely smoothly without us having to do anything.

Solenergy was one of the first companies that I spoke to after receiving the recommendations from Solaquotes.com. After that I spoke to probably 12+ other solar providers, before going back to Solenergy, because they just felt right! Every other Solar company kept trying to sell me a system and saying that they were the best blah, blah. I was so sick of hearing the same sales pitch for every company!Adam from Solenergy on the other hand was patient, he was not in a hurry to sell me anything, he answered all the questions that I had, and he just felt genuine! He provided me a fair quote for the work too and hence I decided to go with them. Within a day or two we had all the paperwork sorted.The installation process went smoothly too. I got an installation day in about a week from signing up, which was awesome! The technicians rocked up on time and it so happens I knew one of the technicians as well (Small world!) The job was done in a day and they took great care not to damage the roof or the walls when installing the panels.Within a couple of weeks or so, the meter change got done by the power retailer and I was good to go!It was a great smooth run from start to finish. They took care of everything, which made it very easy. I would highly recommend Solenergy to anyone.
